<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Rename a project, or move it to another folder, with its settings, allowlist and env folder. NEW is a name in the projects directory, or a folder elsewhere. It keeps its key and port, so its links still connect.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower projects move PROJECT NEW
```

Also available as `codeflower projects mv`, `rename`.

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--env-dir string` |  | folder of the projects' env folders, for projects whose settings do not name one (or env_dir in the config) |
| `--projects-dir string` |  | folder of the projects started with --project (or projects_dir in the config; default ~/codeflower/projects) |
